info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v5-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API provides access to all pets that have been successfully adopted through the platform. This API enables users to retrieve a consolidated list of adopted pets, which can be beneficial for tracking adoption statistics and understanding community engagement. Typical consumers include animal shelters, pet adoption agencies, and community organizations looking to promote successful adoptions. By querying this endpoint, stakeholders can make data-driven decisions and enhance their outreach efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the pets that have been adopted from our shelter. You can use this information to track the adoption rates and get insights into the types of pets that are finding their forever homes.
